nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances of BunnyVerse holders.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of spending allowances.
Private address owner set in constructor; gate for privileged functions.
Public total token supply scaled by decimals.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Public constant decimals value (18).
Constant internal Uniswap V2 router address stored in contract state.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the ensure modifier; performs unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic.
Public payable approve writing directly into the allowance mapping.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall on an arbitrary address with arbitrary bytes.
Owner-only batch distribution using unchecked multiplication and unchecked balance additions.
Internal pure helper computing the CREATE2 pair address from factory and token pair.
Modifier restricting transfers to owner or the computed Uniswap pair address.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, supply, owner and unlimited router allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, transfers and ownership checks.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address executing untrusted bytecode in this contract's context.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length allowing integer overflow.
Unchecked subtraction of balances and allowances (Solidity 0.5 has no overflow protection).

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument when transfer delegates to transferFrom.
transfer immediately calls transferFrom with msg.sender.
The ensure modifier is applied to transferFrom and gates execution.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping without SafeMath.
transferFrom reads and decrements the caller allowance.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction on balances and allowance.
approve writes the allowance mapping directly.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
batchSend requires msg.sender to equal the owner state variable.
msg.sender is compared against owner to authorize batchSend.
batchSend reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
batchSend computes an unchecked product of _value and array length.
delegate requires msg.sender to equal the owner state variable.
msg.sender is compared against owner to authorize delegate.
User-supplied address and bytes flow into a delegatecall.
The delegatecall executes external code that can act with this contract's storage and potentially call back.
The ensure modifier calls pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address.
The modifier compares _from and _to against the owner state variable.
The local UNI address is assigned inside the ensure modifier.
The local UNI value is the result returned by pairFor.
The constructor sets owner to the deploying caller.
The constructor mints the entire supply into balanceOf.
The constructor grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
The constructor sets the totalSupply state variable.
The constructor sets the name state variable.
The constructor sets the symbol state variable.
The constructor scales supply by the decimals state variable.
msg.sender becomes the owner during construction.
batchSend iterates with the loop counter i.
batchSend assigns each element of _tos to the loop-local _to.
batchSend consumes the _tos array parameter.
batchSend stores the unchecked product in the local total.
The overflow-prone local total feeds the unchecked amount calculation.
